dhp273:4:
cakkhumā → mahana aṭhagio śeṭho savana cauri pada 
viraku śeṭho dhamana praṇābhutana cakhuma (prā.dha. A 3 4)
dhp277:4:
visuddhiyā → savi sasara anica ti yada prañaya paśati 
tada nivitti dukha eso magu visodhi a.
dhp278:4:
visuddhiyā → savi sasara dukha ti yada prañapha śradhati 
tada nivinati dukha eṣo mago visodhia. (prā. dha. A 3 1. 2.)
dhp279:4:
visuddhiyā → sarva dhama anatma ti yada paśati vachuma 
tada tivinati dukha eṣo mago visodhi a. (prā. dha. A 3. 3)
dhp280:4:
vindati → utthāna kāleṣū nibhitavīryyāyuvā balī....... ko nirāśaඃ 
sadeva saṃkalpahataඃ kusīdo jñānasya mārgaṃ sattaṃ na vetati. (udānavarga apramāda 5 21.) 
uṭhate alasa anuṭhahatu yoi bali alasae ucito 
saṃsana sagapa mano samatima prañai maga alasu na vinati. (prā. dha. A 3 9)
dhp286:4:
bujjhati → iha varṣaṃ kariṣyāmi hemanghaṃ grīṣmameva ca 
bālo vicintayatīti hyantarāyaṃ na paśyāti (anityavagi 5. 38)
dhp287:4:
gacchati → taṃ putrapaśusampannaṃ vyāsakamanasaṃ naram 
supataṃ vyāghro māgamiva mṛtyurādāya gacchati (mahābhārata. 12. 175) 
taṃ putrapaśūsammattaṃ vyāsaktamānasaṃ taram 
supataṃgrāmaṃ mahogha iva mṛtyurādāya gacchati (udānavarga 1. 5. 39)
